description.value: NICLI Antica Pizzeria at UBC's Wesbrook Village is a full-service Italian restaurant specializing in authentic Neapolitan pizza baked in wood/brick fired ovens imported directly from Naples, cooking each pizza at 900°F in 90 seconds. Open since 2004, it has earned local and international recognition as one of Vancouver's top pizzerias, with a full menu of pizza, pasta, antipasti, cocktails, and Italian wines. The UBC campus location in Wesbrook Village makes it a convenient dine-in or takeout stop for cyclists riding through the university area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the UBC Wesbrook Village location of NICLI Antica Pizzeria at 3339 Shrum Lane, Vancouver, BC V6T 1W5 with phone (604) 563-0012, matching OSM data. Pickup/takeout ordering is explicitly available per the AI info page ('Order for Pickup' at UBC Wesbrook). The menu page states 'Many of our items can be modified to be gluten friendly and/or vegan' and the front page highlights 'Best Gluten Free Pizza'. No cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name 'Nicli Pizzeria + Bar' differs from the website's primary brand 'NICLI Antica Pizzeria'; however, the website's AI info page explicitly lists 'NICLI Pizzeria + Bar (Nicli Antica Pizzeria)' as the brand, confirming both names are intentionally used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant at UBC Wesbrook Village with confirmed address, phone, and live website showing current menu and hours. A practical dine-in or takeout stop for cyclists in the UBC area.
